title: Pemrosesan Paralel & Terdistribusi (+ Tugas-2) (Parallel & Distributed Processing)
lead: Menjelaskan batch vs stream, in-memory, parallel computing. Menganalisis tradeoff tiap teknik + skenario penggunaan. Tugas-2: Analisis & Perancangan Basis Data.

sections.label: Parallel & Distributed Processing
sections.title: 1. Batch vs Stream
body: Batch (Spark, MapReduce): throughput tinggi, latency menit–jam — cocok untuk ETL harian, training ML. Stream (Kafka + Flink/Spark Streaming): latency detik — cocok untuk fraud detection, monitoring. Lambda (batch+speed layer) vs Kappa (semua sebagai stream). Exactly-once butuh idempotent sink.
sections.callout: Bahan Bacaan: Kleppmann (2017) Ch.8-11; Chambers & Zaharia (2018); Buyya et al. (2016)

sections.label: Parallel & Distributed Processing
sections.title: 2. In-Memory & Paralel
body: In-memory (Spark RDD/DataFrame, Redis) menghindari I/O disk berulang — 10–100x untuk iteratif (ML). Paralelisme: partisi data (hash/range), shuffle mahal — minimalkan. Amdahl's law: speedup terbatas oleh bagian sekuensial.

sections.label: Parallel & Distributed Processing
sections.title: 3. Tugas-2
body: TUGAS-2 (30%): Analisis & Perancangan Basis Data — pilih kasus (mis. akademik), rancang OLTP ternormalisasi + star schema + pipeline ETL/ELT + justifikasi NoSQL/lakehouse bila relevan. Kriteria: kebenaran konsep, kelengkapan rancangan, kualitas analisis, presentasi.
sections.callout: Istilah Kunci: Batch vs Stream, Lambda vs Kappa, Exactly-once, Shuffle, In-memory

sections.label: Implementasi Praktis
sections.title: Contoh Kode & Query
body: Berikut adalah contoh kode atau kueri terkait topik modul ini:
sections.callout:
# Spark: batch agregat paralel (in-memory)
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
df = spark.read.parquet("lake/silver/orders/")
rev = (df.groupBy("date").agg(F.sum("amount").alias("revenue"))
         .orderBy("date"))
rev.write.mode("overwrite").parquet("lake/gold/daily_revenue/")
